event_detail: Kettle on the counter right of the stove: the open gripper hovers above it, descends (9.6 s), rises again (11.2 s) and descends again (12.8 s) without grasping.
evidence: Wrist camera shows the kettle below the gripper in all 4 moments, growing and shrinking in size as the arm goes down and up; gripper fingers stay open and empty; shoulder views show the kettle still on the counter and the pan alone on the stove. Could also be a slow normal approach, so confidence is moderate.
